skills.name: Content discovery planning
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Pick wordlists sized to the target (cat_exp_wordlist_builder).
2. Set politeness limits: rate and total requests.
3. Run web.dirbrute with the plan.
4. Filter noise (consistent 404s) with python.run_file.
5. Verify hits manually via http.replay.

skills.name: Parameter discovery
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Collect candidate names from JS bundles (process.exec curl + python.run_file).
2. Probe with harmless values via http.replay.
3. Watch for behavior changes.
4. Automate the sweep with python.run_file.
5. Document discovered params.

skills.name: Virtual host discovery
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Generate candidate hostnames from the domain (python.run_file).
2. Probe via Host header with http.replay.
3. Detect differing responses.
4. Verify interesting vhosts in web.browser.
5. Record findings.

skills.name: Subdomain enumeration
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Start with passive sources (web.search).
2. Brute only with permission and modest lists.
3. Resolve and dedupe via python.run_file.
4. Flag takeover candidates.
5. Update the asset map.

skills.name: API endpoint fuzzing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Derive path candidates from docs and JS (cat_res_bounty_scope_check first).
2. Fuzz with node/python runner at low rate.
3. Cluster by status and response shape.
4. Manually verify anomalies.
5. Save the endpoint list.

skills.name: Header handling fuzzing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Send marker headers via http.replay.
2. Test reflection and parsing quirks.
3. Watch for debug behaviors.
4. Document parser oddities.
5. Report anything exploitable.

skills.name: Form field fuzzing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Map fields from the page (web.browser).
2. Submit boundary values per field via http.replay.
3. Record acceptance/rejection matrix.
4. Automate the matrix build with python.run_file.
5. Report weak validations.

skills.name: Response status mapping
skills.description: Build a status-code map of the app.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Probe key routes with each method via http.replay.
2. Tabulate method x route statuses.
3. Spot unexpected 405/403 patterns.
4. Verify anomalies manually.
5. Save the matrix.

skills.name: Error-triggering input classes
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Send type-confusion inputs (arrays, objects) via http.replay.
2. Record stack traces/versions leaked.
3. Group by root cause.
4. Report info-leak findings.
5. Recommend generic error handling.

skills.name: Fuzz scope guardrails
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Confirm scope before any fuzz run.
2. Cap: requests/sec, total, duration (python.run_file limiter).
3. Monitor for 5xx storms; abort on them.
4. Log the fuzz plan and actuals.
5. Review impact with the owner.

skills.name: WAF calibration for fuzzing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Send calibration probes; fingerprint blocks (python.run_file).
2. Adjust encodings within policy.
3. Keep rate below blocking threshold.
4. Record calibration results.
5. Re-check before long runs.

skills.name: DNS brute methodology
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Use authoritative NS to avoid resolver caching bias (process.exec dig).
2. Modest wordlists; measure NXDOMAIN rates.
3. Detect wildcards first with python.run_file.
4. Verify interesting records.
5. Update the asset map.

skills.name: Port scan planning
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define port ranges from context (web ports vs full).
2. Run net.portscan with sane timing.
3. Fingerprint found services via banners.
4. Map to likely exploits (cat_res_research flows).
5. Record the service map.

skills.name: Credential testing ethics
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Only test accounts you own or with written consent.
2. Prefer lockout-safe patterns; monitor for lockouts.
3. Use tiny wordlists for validation only.
4. Stop at the first success signal.
5. Report methodology honestly.

skills.name: Fuzz result dedup
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Signature responses (status+length+hash) in python.run_file.
2. Cluster and rank by uniqueness.
3. Discard clusters of identical soft-404s.
4. Review the survivors manually.
5. Archive raw results.

skills.name: Directory hit prioritization
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Score by name keywords (admin, api, backup) via python.run_file.
2. Verify top candidates via http.replay.
3. Note auth requirements.
4. Feed the attack surface map.
5. Record the shortlist.

skills.name: Extension fuzzing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Combine stems with common extensions (python.run_file).
2. Probe with HEAD/GET via http.replay.
3. Deduplicate by content hash.
4. Verify meaningful hits (backups, configs).
5. Report exposures.

skills.name: Rate policy design
skills.description: Set explicit rate limits per target.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Agree limits with the owner (or default conservative).
2. Encode them in the runner config (python.run_file).
3. Enforce centrally in the limiter.
4. Log adherence.
5. Review after each run.

skills.name: Fuzz metrics tracking
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Track: requests, hits, unique signatures, time (python.run_file).
2. Compare across wordlists.
3. Keep the best performers.
4. Prune weak lists.
5. Save metrics history.

skills.name: GraphQL field fuzzing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Introspect on your own instance (http.replay).
2. Fuzz fields of interest at low depth.
3. Watch for authz differences.
4. Automate with python.run_file.
5. Document sensitive fields.

skills.name: JWT claim fuzzing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Obtain a valid token (your account).
2. Mutate claims (exp, role) via python.run_file.
3. Replay via http.replay and observe.
4. Record which claims are enforced.
5. Report verification gaps.

skills.name: Cookie attribute fuzzing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Vary cookie names/values via http.replay.
2. Observe session behavior.
3. Check for parsing quirks (delimiters).
4. Document findings.
5. Recommend hardening.

skills.name: HTTP method fuzzing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Probe TRACE/OPTIONS/PATCH on key routes via http.replay.
2. Note unexpected 200s.
3. Check CORS preflight behaviors.
4. Automate with python.run_file.
5. Report risks (TRACE, permissive OPTIONS).

skills.name: Upload filename fuzzing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Generate tricky names (double ext, unicode) via python.run_file.
2. Upload benign contents via http.replay.
3. Observe stored names.
4. Check traversal markers in responses.
5. Report sanitization gaps.

skills.name: Fuzzing report writer
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Collect metrics and findings (file.read).
2. Write methodology, limits, and results via python.run_file.
3. Attach evidence files.
4. Redact sensitive values.
5. Deliver the report.
